subject.answer: real, in the dominant key from its beginning

claims.claim: Real answer is in the dominant key from its beginning
Countersubject is interchangeable at the octave since the two voices never exceed an octave
Bar 7 codetta continues in rising sequence the canon of bars 5-6
Soprano enters at 15 with subject instead of expected answer
Bar 17 has apparently three 6/4 chords in succession with leaping bass (only real 6/4 on C#)
Episode 2 may be regarded as finishing the exposition
Bars 25-32 are an almost exact repetition of bars 4-11 an octave higher, plus a bass in 25-28
Final entry 37-40 is mostly on a dominant pedal
